body:
Founder-authored script, saved verbatim, following founder real-time direction to arbitrarily start the next season as Season 6 after NEVER_LAND's open ending. Flagged and resolved a real numbering conflict: episodes/s06e01-s06e06 already occupy Season 6 as a separate, unrelated arc -- filed as SEASON 6 (TAKE 2) per the founder's own explicit choice. Returns to the main documentary-crew frame (Cam, a sound guy, a PA). Tyler is contaminated by a reactive memory-adhesive residue surfacing a live flip-phone text thread between an unseen 'the Suit' and Hana; ends on a cliffhanger touching the patch's edge and peeling the scene, showing an older/alternate Hana mid-catastrophe. Files: episodes/s06b_e00_the_residue_test.md, EPISODES.md, activity.md, CHANGELOG.md.

⚓ ☃
title: SEASON 6 (TAKE 2) E0 'The Residue Test' (Build 0136)
